idea-plugin.name: Cursorial Designer
idea-plugin.description:
XAML editor and live visual designer for the Cursorial terminal UI framework.

  • Live preview — a split text/preview editor renders your XAML as a real character-cell frame through the framework's own headless host: what you see is what the terminal draws, including theme, color tier, and terminal capability profiles (switchable from the toolbar).
  • Code completion — elements with contextual filtering, properties and attached properties, enum/bool/GridLength values, markup extensions, binding paths with source inference, resource keys, style selectors (pseudo-classes, style classes, combinators), types, and xmlns-aware prefix narrowing.
  • Live diagnostics — parse AND build-phase errors as you type, in the editor and the Problems view.
  • Navigation and docs — go-to-definition into your sources (portable PDB based), quick documentation from XML doc files, in-document jumps for named elements, resource keys, and selector references.
  • Semantic highlighting — extension arguments, selector paths, binding paths, type-aware values, with a dedicated color settings page.
  • Element inspector — click to select elements in the preview, walk the element chain, and inspect property values with full provenance (local, style, template, inherited, theme default) plus per-cell composition sampling.

Requires the .NET 10 SDK (dotnet on the PATH) — the same SDK Cursorial app development already needs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

Matches Cursorial 0.5.0.

Preview

  • Views with x:Class are live-sourced from the project, so the preview renders what the code-behind actually builds.
  • The preview watches its XAML dependencies and reloads when any of them changes.
  • The language service restarts when the user assembly is rebuilt.
  • Pointer key modifiers are forwarded from the preview pane.
  • New vt100 terminal profile — monochrome, no mouse.
  • Split proportions no longer sync across documents or orientations.
  • DataViews controls are available to previewed documents.

Code insight

  • {TemplateBinding} completes and resolves the template target's members.
  • Property-element and Setter completion, including element-form-only scalars.
  • Binding paths re-scope through ancestor DataContext bindings.
  • Markup extensions complete in element form.
  • Style.RequiresCapabilities completes as a flags-aware value list.

Navigation and documentation

  • Ctrl+B on a resource URI opens the referenced document.
  • x:Class hover, navigation and highlighting.
  • Both halves of an {x:Static} path navigate and document.
  • Named-element navigation is scoped to the reference's template name scope.

Inspector

  • DesiredSize and Bounds rows.

Fixes

  • Editor services are pinned against user-assembly provider hijacks.
  • Cleared the plugin verifier's compatibility and internal-API findings against recent Rider builds.

0.1.0

Initial release: live character-cell preview with theme/tier/capability switching, completion, live parse + build diagnostics, semantic highlighting, quick docs, go-to-definition, element inspector with property provenance, and dotnet-new template awareness. Matches Cursorial 0.4.0.
